senses.gloss:
Kalodayāloka
mantra-vedānta. by Vimarśānandaśakti. Hz. 1784. TD. 15577 (with text).

Kallola
vallabhīya. by Kalyāṇa Bhaṭṭa. Jaṭāśaṅkar 52.

Kallolakaraṇa
jy. by Śrī Rāma. Q. in Kautukacintāmaṇi of Rāma, BBRAS. 226.

Kallolajātaka
jy. by Raghunātha Paṇḍita. Oudh VIII. 14.

Kallolabhaṭṭācārya
of Andhra; son of Kesari Bhaṭṭa an. grandson of Sujana Bhaṭṭa (a. of Śabdaliṅgārthacandrikā. lex. MD. 1759-61); father of Mukundanārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa an. grandfather of Cakora Bhaṭṭācārya (a. of Śarat, C.. on Dṛṣṭāntasiddhāñjana, Adyar D. VI. 1019. 1020. MD. 1605. 1606, itself a C. on Śabdaliṅgārthacandrikā).
--Dṛṣṭāntasiddhāñjana, C. on his grandfather's Śabdaliṅgārthacandrikā. Adyar II. p. 43a. Adyar D. VI. 1019. 1020. MD. 1762-3. MT. 1720 (b). Taylor II. 375.
On this a C. called Śarat was written by his grandson Cakora Bhaṭṭācārya.
For a list of authorities cited in the two C.s, see ‘Manuscript Notes’, Adyar Library Bulletin, VII. (1943), p.. 37-45; J. of Tanj. Sar. Mah. Lib. III. i. p.. 21-25. See also p. 7. Intro. V. Raghavan's edn. of Amaramaṇḍana, [Page263-b] DCRI. Poona, 1949 an. NCC. II. p.. 317b-318a.

Kallolinīśrīmata(-uttara-)
ref. to by Navamīsiṁha in his Tantracintāmaṇi, RASB. VIII. A. 6217.

Kālocitamantramālā
--Annasūktābhiśravaṇa from.
Pt.. Śrīkṣetra, Gokarṇa, 1924.
--Rudrādhyāya with Mahānyāsa-camakādi from.
Pt.. ibid. 1925.
--Varuṇasūktādi from.
Pt.. ibid. 1926. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1230.

Kālottara
(tantra or Agama) Śaivāgama. dialogue between Śiva an. Kārttikeya; three recensions are known (1) a large recension (2) one in 1300 ślokas an. (3) the third in 700 ślokas. See Nepal I. Preface p. lix.
Different texts of this name-Skāndaº, Devīº, Devīdviśatīº, Triśatīº, etc. are q. in śaiva works.
GD. 657F. Granthappura p. 28, no. 657F (Paṭalas 65-6). Hpr. I. 63. Kāṭm. 12. Nepal I. p.. 6 (inc.). 8 (inc.). 9-10 (Bṛhat Kālottara, inc.). 37-38 (version in 1300 verses, inc.). 73 (25 Paṭalas). 80 (Kālottara or Kālajñāna) (inc.). 96 (version in 700 verses).
Q. by Somānanda in Śivadṛṣṭi III. II. 63, Kas. Texts 55; by Abhinavagupta in Tantrāloka, Vol. 7, Āh. 11, p. 11 an. Parātriṁśikātattvavivaraṇa, IO. i. p. 840a; by Jayaratha in his C. [Page082-b] on Tantrāloka VII. Kas. Texts 41. p. 13; by Kṣemarāja in Svacchandoddyota III. Kas. Texts 44. p. 269 an. in his C. on Sāmbapañcāśikā 21 (K. M. 13. p. 12); by Raghunātha Tarkavāgīśa in Āgamatattvavilāsa, L. 3186; by Navamīsiṁha (or Dāmodara) in his Tantracintāmaṇi, RASB. VIII. A. 6217; by Rāghava Bhaṭṭa in his C. Padārthādarśa on Śāradātilaka, (Kas. Texts 3. III. 1, 71; 72; 70-1, 112: see ABORI. XLI. p. 33); by Nīlakaṇṭha in the Intro. to his C. on Devībhāgavata (p.. 31, 38. Calcutta edn.; see IHQ. XVI. p. 575); in Siṁhasiddhāntasindhu (fol. 60b. 132a, Anup Sanskrit Library ms.), of Śivānanda Gosvāmin alias Śiromaṇi Bhaṭṭa written in 1674 A. D. (see D.. C. Kunhan Raja Presentation Vol. p. 370: ‘Śivānanda Gosvāmin’ by Madhava Krishna Sarma); by Mādhava in his Sarvadarśanasaṅgraha (Śaivadarśana, p. 185. BORI. edn.); by Hemādri in Dānakhaṇḍa (p. 384, Kāl. Śaivaśāstra); by Raghunandana in his Malamāsa an. Dīkṣā Tattvas (Serampore edn. I. p. 454; II. p. 370); by Vidyāpati in his Gaṅgāvākyāvali JASB. (NS) XI (1915) p. 390; by Bhaṭṭoji Dīkṣita in his Tithinirṇayasaṁkṣepa, Lz. 548; in Paraśurāmapratāpa, Saṁskārakāṇḍa (fol. 17a. BORI. 157 of Viś. (i); see Poona Ori. VII. p. 13).
--Mudrāpaṭala from. RASB. VIII. A 5898 (fr.).
--C. by Rāmakāṇḍa (Rāmakaṇṭha ?). mentioned by Mādhava in his Sarvadarśanasaṅgraha, Śaivadarśana, p. 71 (Ānandāśrama edn.), p. 185 (BORI. edn.).

Kālottara
jy. by Nandikeśvara. SSPC. II. F. 2.

Kālodyota
dh. by Rāmakṛṣṇa. BISM. thi. 990.

Kālopa
one of the divisions according to the Rāṇāyanīya recension of Sv. listed in Caraṇavyūha. See TD. 1763.

Kālopaniṣad_(?)
B. I. 60 mistake for Kauloº?
